fullPassage: Some people view old age as inevitably depressing. They assume that the older you get, the greater the deterioration in quality of life. Of course it is true that the longer you live, the more opportunity you have of experiencing negative as well as positive events. And certain illnesses, aches, pains, and disabilities do become more likely with increasing age, as do losses of family, friends, and social support. Therefore, some sadness is to be expected. Nonetheless, depression is absolutely not an inevitable consequence of old age. Most symptoms of depression in the elderly are identical to those in people of all ages. However, the elderly are more likely to focus on the physical and to talk about their aches and pains rather than their feelings of despair. Furthermore, elderly people commonly express regret and remorse about past events in their lives.

✅ ① the longer you live: the + 비교급 구조 — 원문 일치
❌ ② as does losses → as do losses (losses = 복수 주어 → 복수 대동사 do. does는 단수 → 비문)
✅ ③ absolutely not: 부사 + 부정어 — 원문 일치
✅ ④ identical to: identical + to 전치사 — 원문 일치
det.tip: 대동사 수 일치: 주어가 복수(losses) → do. 단수 → does. losses는 복수 → do.

questions.passage: Some people view old age as inevitably depressing. They assume that the older you get, the greater the deterioration in quality of life. Of course it is true that the longer you live, the more opportunity you have of experiencing negative as well as positive events. And certain illnesses, aches, pains, and disabilities do become more likely with increasing age, as do losses of family, friends, and social support. Therefore, some sadness is to be expected. Nonetheless, depression is absolutely not an inevitable consequence of old age. Most symptoms of depression in the elderly are identical to those in people of all ages. However, the elderly are more likely to focus on the physical and to talk about their aches and pains rather than their feelings of despair. Furthermore, elderly people commonly express regret and remorse about past events in their lives.

det.korean: 노년기 우울증이 불가피한 결과가 아님을 표현하는 핵심 구절.
det.analysis: S6: depression is absolutely not an inevitable consequence of old age → 핵심 5단어: not(1) an(2) inevitable(3) consequence(4) of(5)
det.tip: S6: absolutely not an inevitable consequence — 반전 핵심 표현.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: S6+S7: 우울증은 불가피한 결과가 아니며 모든 연령층의 증상과 동일 — 지문 전체 메시지.
det.analysis:
✅ ① S6+S7: 불가피하지 않음 + 다른 연령층과 동일 — 핵심 주제
❌ ② S2+S4: 부정적 시각 소개에 불과. 지문은 이를 반박함
❌ ③ 치료 방법: 본문에 치료 내용 없음
❌ ④ 사회적 지지 상실 = S4 부분 내용. 주요 원인이라는 결론 없음
det.tip: S6: absolutely not inevitable + S7: identical to all ages = 주제 핵심.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: S6+S8: 우울증은 불가피하지 않음 + 노인들은 신체 증상을 더 이야기하고 절망감은 표현 회피 — 지문 핵심 요지.
det.analysis:
❌ ① '예방해야 한다'는 결론은 본문에 없음
❌ ② S7: identical to other ages — 다르게 접근해야 한다는 내용 없음
✅ ③ S6+S8: 불가피하지 않음 + 신체 증상 편향 표현 — 요지 정확히 반영
❌ ④ 사회적 지지망 = S4 부분 언급. 가장 중요한 요소라는 결론 없음
det.tip: S6+S8 조합: 우울증 불가피하지 않음 + 신체 증상 집중/절망감 회피 = 요지.
